All jewelry is real metal, sitting in real, calm, healthy skin — no redness, no swelling, no irritation — with a small natural warm shadow under each piece. Every piece stays at least a finger's width from the eyeballs, and no chain or bar crosses the eyes.

Piercing depth: every bar is embedded in the skin so only its two end studs show on the surface; every ring passes through a small healed opening in the skin, the skin visible through the loop, and every stud sits through the skin with its back hidden, all of them passing through the real tissue with the skin wrapping snugly around them.

Hair: every woman's hair is swept back behind both ears, leaving both ears, jawlines, necks and foreheads fully visible so every earring and every forehead tattoo is in clear view.

Pose: all five women stand upright, arms relaxed, heads level and facing the camera; #2 and #3 lean very slightly toward the centre, #5 stands straight in the middle, #4 leans very slightly forward, and #1 stands tall in the gap behind them. The hanging ear pieces of #1, #2, #3 and #5 end no lower than the level of their own chins so that they hang in clear view, those of #4 hang in front of her own neck and shoulder down to the level of her collarbones, and no hanging piece of one woman hangs in front of another woman's face. They all share one single continuous background behind them, the same one for all of them, with no separate panels, no split screen, no borders and no different backgrounds behind different women. There is no dividing line between the women, and no different light, colour or background on different women. Every woman's tongue hangs straight down in front of her own chin and neck, none of them in front of another woman's face.

Lighting: The background is a city street at night in the rain, blurred neon signs and car lights in teal and deep blue, out of focus with a shallow depth of field, with no objects and no other people in the background, and the background is darker and softer than their faces so that their faces and the metal are the brightest, sharpest part of the image. The background colours are cool, mid-to-dark tones clearly different from their skin tones, never beige, peach, orange or brown, and never bright. One single light setup lights everyone from the same direction with the same colour, so the shadows and highlights match on every woman. A soft frontal light on all the faces and ears, so the makeup and the glints on every piece of metal read clearly; a thin cool rim light along the hair and shoulders. 3:4 vertical 8K.
